coordinate_convention: standard_module frame: USB toward -Y, D0 on left at(-7.62,-7.62). Convert official SMD footprint(u,v) to(x=v,y=-u). Board transform: X=cx+x cos(theta)+y sin(theta), Y=cy-x sin(theta)+y cos(theta). Mating pairs viewed through common assembly frame use same coordinates; do not renumber by a mirrored underside picture.
